data: {{Top}} {{Otheruses|unidentified planet}} {{Conjecture}} {{Image}} {{CelestialBody |image= |name=Unidentified planet (hill town) |region= |sector= |system= |coordinates= |xyz= |distance= |suns= |orbited= |position= |moons= |routes= |lengthday= |lengthyear= |class=Terrestrial{{Andor|Make It Stop}} |diameter= |atmosphere=[[Atmosphere|Type I]] {{C|breathable}}"[[Make It Stop]]" establishes that the [[planet]] had a breathable [[atmosphere]] that {{BuildFalconCite|43|Secrets of Spaceflight}} classifies as Type I. |climate= |gravity= |terrain=*Hills *[[Water|Rivers]] |water= |interest=A [[Unidentified hill town|hill town]] |flora= |fauna= |otherlife= |species= |otherspecies=*[[Human]]s *A [[Unidentified long-legged species|long-legged species]] |socialgroup= |language= |government= |population= |demonym= |cities= |imports= |exports= |affiliation=[[Galactic Empire]] }} A '''planet''' that contained hills and [[Water|rivers]] was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. Between [[18 BBY]] and [[15 BBY]],{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-interview-stellan-skarsgard-elizabeth-dulau|text=Andor's Stellan Skarsgård and Elizabeth Dulau Break Down Luthen and Kleya}} states that [[Kleya Marki]] and [[Luthen Rael]] had known each other for 17 [[Standard year|years]] by the events of "[[Who Else Knows?]]" The episode occurs directly after "[[Make It Stop]]," which dates itself to [[1 BBY]]. Therefore, Marki and Rael's first meeting and Rael's subsequent defection occurred around the year [[18 BBY]]. "Make It Stop" establishes that the execution of the five civilians on a [[Unidentified planet (hill town)|planet]] takes place before the creation of the [[Axis network]], which "[[Coruscant: Whispers of Rebellion]]" states was founded a [[Standard decade|decade]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']] [[Andor Season 1|Season 1]], which takes place in [[5 BBY]] per the reasoning [[:Template:AndorDate|here]]. Therefore, the bombing must have occurred between 18 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and [[15 BBY]]. the [[human]] [[Axis network|rebels]] [[Luthen Rael]] and [[Kleya Marki]] were present on the [[planet]]. {{Planet-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st}} {{Flash}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Galactic Empire planets]] [[Category:Terrestrial planets]]
